invariants: Keep private data out of public sources; preserve advisory materials-only boundaries.
modules.purpose: Portable materials-only instructions, coordinators, workflow and public documentation.

invariants: The manifest is the roster: every card and index must match it.
modules.purpose: Families, roles, slugs and sensitivity that drive indexes, registry, packs and checks.

invariants: Standard library only; every check has a success and a failure test.
modules.purpose: Build, check and search tooling, Claude Code maintainer commands and hook, and their failure-path tests.

invariants: Fictional fixtures only; every card has a task fixture and every family a boundary fixture; host integrations stay outside the shipped pack.
modules.purpose: Fixture tasks and the Claude Code harness that runs each card in fresh subagents and grades it against its Acceptance line.

invariants: Experimental and outside the shipped pack: read-only tools, generated from the cards, never edited by hand.
modules.purpose: Claude Code subagents generated from the catalog cards, kept apart from the pack until evidence supports them.
